description: Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms - Order Under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21/2003
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003, specifying a Special Mediation Board Area. It constitutes a regulatory action and the exercise of statutory powers granted by existing legislation. While it names a minister, it does so only to identify the authority making the order and does not describe her portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel appointment. The core content is purely legal/regulatory in nature, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
